    for (i = 0; i < nc; i++) { out.byChan[i] = 0; }
    for (i = 0; i < nb; i++) { out.byBand[i] = 0; }
    for (i = 0; i < nt; i++) { out.byType[i] = 0; }
    for (i = 0; i < nm * nb; i++) { out.byMonthBand[i] = 0; }
    for (i = 0; i < nc * nb; i++) { out.byChanBand[i] = 0; }

    var hiIdx = D.dim.bands.indexOf('HIGH');

    for (i = 0; i < n; i += STRIDE) {
      var mi = c[i], ci = c[i + 1], bi = c[i + 2], ti = c[i + 3];
      if (!skipM && !monthIn(mi)) continue;
      if (!skipC && !isOn(S.ch, ci)) continue;
      if (!skipB && !isOn(S.bd, bi)) continue;
      if (!skipT && !isOn(S.tp, ti)) continue;

      var t = c[i + 4], a = c[i + 5], ap = c[i + 6], dc = c[i + 7];
      out.txns += t; out.amt += a; out.appr += ap; out.dec += dc;
      if (bi === hiIdx) { out.alerts += t; out.alertAmt += a; }
      out.byMonth[mi] += t;
      out.byChan[ci] += t;
      out.byBand[bi] += t;
      out.byType[ti] += t;
      out.byMonthBand[mi * nb + bi] += t;
      out.byChanBand[ci * nb + bi] += t;
    }
    return out;
  }

  function monthIn(mi) {
    if (S.m0 == null || S.m1 == null) return true;
    var lo = Math.min(S.m0, S.m1), hi = Math.max(S.m0, S.m1);
    return mi >= lo && mi <= hi;
  }

  /* =========================================================================
   * RENDER
   * ====================================================================== */
  function render() {
    D = window.__fcData || window.FC_FIXTURE;
    root = ensureRoot();
    if (!D || !D.dim) {
      root.className = 'fco';
      root.innerHTML = '<div class=""fco-err"">Waiting for data. The measure did not supply <code>window.__fcData</code>.</div>';
      return;
    }

    root.className = 'fco';
    var page = D.page || 'overview';

    if (page === 'guide') {
      root.innerHTML = renderGuide();
      wire();
      return;
    }
    if (page === 'rules') {
      root.innerHTML = renderRules();
      wire();
      return;
    }
    if (page === 'risk') {
      root.innerHTML = renderRisk();
      wire();
      return;
    }

    var A = scan();
    var nb = D.dim.bands.length;

    root.innerHTML =
      header(A) + filters() + kpis(A) +
      '<div class=""fco-bd"">' +
        panelTrend(A, nb) +
        panelChannel(A, nb) +
        panelSplit(A) +
        panelRules() +
      '</div>';

    wire();
  }

  function header(A) {
    var T = D.totals || {};
    var pctShown = T.txns ? A.txns / T.txns : 1;
    return '<div class=""fco-hd"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-ttl"">Financial Crime Overview</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-sub"">transaction monitoring ' + DOT + ' ' +
        esc(D.dim.months.length) + ' months</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-spacer""></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-scope""><b>' + full(A.txns) + '</b> of ' + full(T.txns || A.txns) +
        ' transactions in scope (' + pct(pctShown, 1) + ')</div>' +
      '</div>';
  }

  function filters() {
    var h = '<div class=""fco-flt"">';
    h += '<div class=""fco-grp""><span class=""fco-lbl"">Risk</span>';
    for (var b = 0; b < D.dim.bands.length; b++) {
      h += '<span class=""fco-chip b' + b + (S.bd[b] ? ' on' : '') +
        '"" data-k=""bd"" data-i=""' + b + '"">' + esc(D.dim.bands[b]) + '</span>';
    }
    h += '</div>';

    h += '<div class=""fco-grp""><span class=""fco-lbl"">Channel</span>';
    for (var c = 0; c < D.dim.channels.length; c++) {
      h += '<span class=""fco-chip' + (S.ch[c] ? ' on' : '') +
        '"" data-k=""ch"" data-i=""' + c + '"">' + esc(label(D.dim.channels[c])) + '</span>';
    }
    h += '</div>';

    h += '<div class=""fco-grp""><span class=""fco-lbl"">Type</span>';
    for (var t = 0; t < D.dim.types.length; t++) {
      h += '<span class=""fco-chip' + (S.tp[t] ? ' on' : '') +
        '"" data-k=""tp"" data-i=""' + t + '"">' + esc(label(D.dim.types[t])) + '</span>';
    }
    h += '</div>';

    var live = anyOn(S.ch) || anyOn(S.bd) || anyOn(S.tp) || S.m0 != null;
    if (live) h += '<span class=""fco-reset"" data-k=""reset"">Clear all filters</span>';
    return h + '</div>';
  }

  function label(s) {
    if (s == null || s === '' || s === '(blank)') return 'Blank';
    return String(s).replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\w\S*/g, function (w) {
      return w.charAt(0) + w.slice(1).toLowerCase();
    });
  }

  function kpis(A) {
    var rate = A.txns ? A.alerts / A.txns : 0;
    // Denominator is transactions that GOT a decision, matching the model's
    // [Approval Rate]. Dividing by every transaction silently understates it.
    var appr = A.dec ? A.appr / A.dec : 0;
    var years = A.alerts / 50000;
    var k = [
      ['Transactions', full(A.txns), money(A.amt) + ' total value'],
      ['Alerts raised', full(A.alerts), 'risk band HIGH'],
      ['LEAD', pct(rate), 'Alert rate'],
      ['Exposure at risk', money(A.alertAmt), 'value behind alerts'],
      ['Approval rate', pct(appr, 1), full(A.dec) + ' had a decision'],
      ['Analyst years', years.toFixed(1), 'at 50,000 alerts a year']
    ];
    var h = '<div class=""fco-kpi"">';
    for (var i = 0; i < k.length; i++) {
      if (k[i][0] === 'LEAD') {
        h += '<div class=""fco-k lead""><div class=""fco-kl"">' + esc(k[i][2]) + '</div>' +
          '<div class=""fco-kv"">' + esc(k[i][1]) + '</div>' +
          '<div class=""fco-kn"">share of transactions alerted</div></div>';
      } else {
        h += '<div class=""fco-k""><div class=""fco-kl"">' + esc(k[i][0]) + '</div>' +
          '<div class=""fco-kv"">' + esc(k[i][1]) + '</div>' +
          '<div class=""fco-kn"">' + esc(k[i][2]) + '</div></div>';
      }
    }
    return h + '</div>';
  }

  function panelTrend(A, nb) {
    // Months are scanned without the month filter so the brush shows context:
    // the bars you excluded stay visible, dimmed, instead of vanishing.
    var ctx = scan({ allMonths: true });
    var max = 0, i;
    for (i = 0; i < ctx.byMonth.length; i++) { if (ctx.byMonth[i] > max) max = ctx.byMonth[i]; }

    var h = '<div class=""fco-p"" style=""grid-row:1;grid-column:1"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-ph""><div class=""fco-pt"">Transactions by month</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-pn"">click a bar to filter ' + DOT + ' shift-click for a range</div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-tr"" data-k=""trend"">';

    for (i = 0; i < D.dim.months.length; i++) {
      var inR = monthIn(i);
      var tot = ctx.byMonth[i];
      h += '<div class=""fco-col' + (inR ? '' : ' dim') + '"" data-k=""m"" data-i=""' + i + '"" ' +
        'title=""' + esc(D.dim.months[i][1]) + ': ' + full(tot) + ' transactions"">';
      // Stack HIGH on top so the eye lands on it.
      for (var b = nb - 1; b >= 0; b--) {
        var v = ctx.byMonthBand[i * nb + b];
        var pxh = max ? (v / max) * 100 : 0;
        if (pxh > 0) {
          h += '<div class=""fco-seg s' + b + '"" style=""height:' + pxh.toFixed(2) + '%""></div>';
        }
      }
      var lab = D.dim.months[i][1];
      var isUnknown = D.dim.months[i][0] === 0;
      var show = isUnknown || (i % 4 === 0);
      h += '<div class=""fco-cx"">' +
        esc(show ? (isUnknown ? 'Unknown' : lab.replace(' 20', "" '"")) : '') + '</div>';
      h += '</div>';
    }
    return h + '</div></div>';
  }

  function panelChannel(A, nb) {
    var ctx = scan({ allChannels: true });
    var max = 0, i;
    for (i = 0; i < ctx.byChan.length; i++) { if (ctx.byChan[i] > max) max = ctx.byChan[i]; }

    var order = [];
    for (i = 0; i < D.dim.channels.length; i++) { order.push(i); }
    order.sort(function (a, b) { return ctx.byChan[b] - ctx.byChan[a]; });

    var h = '<div class=""fco-p"" style=""grid-row:1;grid-column:2"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-ph""><div class=""fco-pt"">Channel</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-pn"">stacked by risk band</div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-rows spread"">';
    for (var k = 0; k < order.length; k++) {
      var ci = order[k], tot = ctx.byChan[ci];
      var on = isOn(S.ch, ci);
      h += '<div class=""fco-row' + (on ? '' : ' dim') + '"" data-k=""ch"" data-i=""' + ci + '"">' +
        '<div class=""fco-rl"">' + esc(label(D.dim.channels[ci])) + '</div><div class=""fco-rb"">';
      for (var b = 0; b < nb; b++) {
        var v = ctx.byChanBand[ci * nb + b];
        var w = max ? (v / max) * 100 : 0;
        if (w > 0) h += '<div class=""fco-rf s' + b + '"" style=""width:' + w.toFixed(2) + '%""></div>';
      }
      h += '</div><div class=""fco-rv"">' + num(tot) + '</div></div>';
    }
    return h + '</div></div>';
  }

  function panelSplit(A) {
    var nb = D.dim.bands.length;
    var h = '<div class=""fco-p"" style=""grid-row:2;grid-column:1"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-ph""><div class=""fco-pt"">Composition</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-pn"">within the current filter</div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-rows"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-gh"">By risk band, share of transactions</div>';

    var maxB = 0, i;
    for (i = 0; i < nb; i++) { if (A.byBand[i] > maxB) maxB = A.byBand[i]; }
    for (i = 0; i < nb; i++) {
      var w = maxB ? (A.byBand[i] / maxB) * 100 : 0;
      var share = A.txns ? A.byBand[i] / A.txns : 0;
      h += '<div class=""fco-row' + (isOn(S.bd, i) ? '' : ' dim') + '"" data-k=""bd"" data-i=""' + i + '"">' +
        '<div class=""fco-rl"">' + esc(D.dim.bands[i]) + '</div>' +
        '<div class=""fco-rb""><div class=""fco-rf s' + i + '"" style=""width:' + w.toFixed(2) + '%""></div></div>' +
        '<div class=""fco-rv"">' + pct(share, 1) + '</div></div>';
    }

    h += '<div class=""fco-gh t"">By transaction type, count</div>';

    var maxT = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < D.dim.types.length; i++) { if (A.byType[i] > maxT) maxT = A.byType[i]; }
    for (i = 0; i < D.dim.types.length; i++) {
      var wt = maxT ? (A.byType[i] / maxT) * 100 : 0;
      h += '<div class=""fco-row' + (isOn(S.tp, i) ? '' : ' dim') + '"" data-k=""tp"" data-i=""' + i + '"">' +
        '<div class=""fco-rl"">' + esc(label(D.dim.types[i])) + '</div>' +
        '<div class=""fco-rb""><div class=""fco-rf tp"" style=""width:' + wt.toFixed(2) +
        '%""></div></div>' +
        '<div class=""fco-rv"">' + num(A.byType[i]) + '</div></div>';
    }
    return h + '</div></div>';
  }

  function panelRules() {
    var rules = (D.dim && D.dim.rules) || [];
    var h = '<div class=""fco-p"" style=""grid-row:2;grid-column:2"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-ph""><div class=""fco-pt"">Rule firings</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-pn"">report filter context</div></div>';

    if (!rules.length) {
      return h + '<div class=""fco-empty"">No rules in the payload.</div></div>';
    }
    var max = 0, i;
    for (i = 0; i < rules.length; i++) { if (rules[i][3] > max) max = rules[i][3]; }

    h += '<div class=""fco-tb""><table><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>Rule</th><th>Wt</th><th>Firings</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
    for (i = 0; i < rules.length; i++) {
      var r = rules[i];
      var w = max ? (r[3] / max) * 42 : 0;
      h += '<tr><td class=""nm"" title=""' + esc(r[1]) + '"">' + esc(r[1]) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r[2]) + '</td>' +
        '<td><b>' + num(r[3]) + '</b>' +
        '<span class=""fco-bar"" style=""width:' + w.toFixed(1) + 'px""></span></td></tr>';
    }
    h += '</tbody></table></div>';
    // A rule firing is a contribution to a score, not a work item. Saying so on
    // the page is the difference between 39.6M ""alerts"" and 1.4M real ones.
    h += '<div class=""fco-pn"" style=""margin-top:6px;margin-left:0"">' +
      'A firing contributes to the score. An alert is the score crossing the band. '
      + 'These counts follow report filters, not the chips above.</div>';
    return h + '</div>';
  }


  /* =========================================================================
   * GUIDE PAGE
   * Seven sections behind a nav, a pipeline you can open a stage at a time, and
   * a threshold demonstrator that recomputes from the real score histogram.
   *
   * The demonstrator matters more than the prose around it. ""An alert is not a
   * rule firing"" is a sentence people nod at and then forget; dragging the
   * cut-off and watching 7.1m alerts become 51k, and 57 analysts become none,
   * is the thing that actually lands.
   * ====================================================================== */

  var GSECTIONS = [
    ['start', 'Start here'],
    ['pipeline', 'How the data gets here'],
    ['alerts', 'Firing vs alert'],
    ['pages', 'The pages'],
    ['numbers', 'Reading the numbers'],
    ['quality', 'Data quality'],
    ['limits', 'What this cannot do']
  ];

  var GSTAGES = [
    ['PostgreSQL', 'on-premises',
     'A single wide table, 100 columns, every one of them text. Nothing is ' +
     'cleaned on the way in: a landing zone that rejects rows is not a landing ' +
     'zone. Values like <code>1,234.50</code>, <code>(45.00)</code>, ' +
     '<code>RM99.00</code> and <code>9999-12-31</code> all land exactly as the ' +
     'source produced them.'],
    ['Open mirroring', 'Postgres to OneLake',
     'Fabric cannot reach a database on localhost, and PostgreSQL on-premises ' +
     'is not a supported native mirroring source. So the publisher writes ' +
     'Parquet into a landing zone and Fabric applies it to Delta tables: an ' +
     'initial seed, then continuous change data capture from the write-ahead ' +
     'log. Inserts, updates and deletes all propagate.'],
    ['DuckDB', 'clean, conform, model',
     'Typing, parsing and conforming happen here, on 8 vCores. Five competing ' +
     'date formats resolved, 32 spellings of one country collapsed to one code, ' +
     'exact duplicates removed, then a star schema with explicit Unknown ' +
     'members so no fact is ever orphaned by a missing dimension.'],
    ['Direct Lake', 'the semantic model',
     'Nine tables, eight relationships, seventeen measures over the gold layer. ' +
     'Direct Lake reads the Delta files directly: no import, no refresh window, ' +
     'and no copy of the data sitting in a second place going stale.'],
    ['This report', 'one measure per page',
     'Each page is a single HTML visual. Its measure aggregates in the model ' +
     'and ships a compact cube; the browser does layout, ranking and filtering ' +
     'from there. Clicking inside a page never queries the model again.']
  ];

  function gnav() {
    var cur = S.gsec || 'start';
    var h = '<div class=""fco-gnav"">';
    for (var i = 0; i < GSECTIONS.length; i++) {
      var id = GSECTIONS[i][0];
      h += '<div class=""fco-gn' + (id === cur ? ' on' : '') +
        '"" data-k=""gsec"" data-v=""' + id + '"">' +
        '<span class=""fco-gnn"">' + (i + 1) + '</span>' +
        esc(GSECTIONS[i][1]) + '</div>';
    }
    return h + '</div>';
  }

  /* Alerts above a cut-off, straight off the histogram. A tail sum is all a
   * threshold ever is, which is why this needs no round trip. */
  function alertsAbove(cut) {
    var hist = D.hist || [], n = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < hist.length; i += 2) {
      if (hist[i] >= cut) n += hist[i + 1];
    }
    return n;
  }

  function gThresholdDemo() {
    var m = D.meta || {};
    var lo = 10, hi = Math.min(100, m.maxScore || 145);
    var cur = S.gthr == null ? (m.threshold || 60) : S.gthr;
    var al = alertsAbove(cur);
    var rate = m.txns ? al / m.txns : 0;
    var years = al / 50000;
    var fte = years / 2.5;
    var isDefault = (cur === (m.threshold || 60));

    var h = '<div class=""fco-demo"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-demo-h"">Move the cut-off and watch what it costs</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-chips"">';
    for (var c = lo; c <= hi; c += 10) {
      h += '<span class=""fco-chip' + (c === cur ? ' on' : '') +
        '"" data-k=""gthr"" data-v=""' + c + '"">' + c + '</span>';
    }
    h += '</div><div class=""fco-demo-out"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-do""><div class=""fco-dol"">Alerts raised</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-dov"">' + full(al) + '</div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-do""><div class=""fco-dol"">Alert rate</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-dov"">' + pct(rate, 2) + '</div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-do""><div class=""fco-dol"">Analyst years</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-dov"">' + years.toFixed(1) + '</div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-do lead""><div class=""fco-dol"">Analysts needed</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-dov"">' + fte.toFixed(0) + '</div></div>' +
      '</div>';

    // The distribution, with the chosen cut-off marked.
    var hist = D.hist || [], maxH = 0, i;
    for (i = 0; i < hist.length; i += 2) { if (hist[i + 1] > maxH) maxH = hist[i + 1]; }
    h += '<div class=""fco-demo-hist"">';
    for (i = 0; i < hist.length; i += 2) {
      var bk = hist[i];
      var ph = maxH ? (hist[i + 1] / maxH) * 100 : 0;
      h += '<div class=""fco-dhb"" title=""score ' + bk + ' to ' + (bk + 4) + ': ' +
        full(hist[i + 1]) + '""><div class=""fco-dhf' + (bk >= cur ? ' on' : '') +
        '"" style=""height:' + ph.toFixed(2) + '%""></div></div>';
    }
    h += '</div><div class=""fco-demo-ax""><span>score 0</span><span>' +
      (hist.length ? hist[hist.length - 2] + 4 : 145) + '</span></div>';

    h += '<div class=""fco-note"">' +
      (isDefault
        ? 'This is the threshold the model actually uses: the HIGH band starts ' +
          'at <b>' + cur + '</b>.'
        : 'The model uses <b>' + (m.threshold || 60) + '</b>. At <b>' + cur +
          '</b> the queue would be ' +
          (al > (m.alerts || 0) ? 'larger' : 'smaller') + ', needing ' +
          fte.toFixed(0) + ' analysts instead of ' +
          ((m.alerts || 0) / 50000 / 2.5).toFixed(0) + '.') +
      '</div></div>';
    return h;
  }

  function gFiringVsAlert() {
    var m = D.meta || {};
    var wr = m.txnsWithRule || 0, al = m.alerts || 0, tx = m.txns || 1;
    var wrPct = wr / tx, alPct = al / tx;
    return '<div class=""fco-compare"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp-t"">If any rule firing were an alert</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp-bar""><div class=""fco-cmp-f bad"" style=""width:' +
      (wrPct * 100).toFixed(1) + '%""></div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp-v"">' + full(wr) + ' <span>' + pct(wrPct, 1) +
      ' of transactions</span></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp-n"">About ' + Math.round(wr / 50000 / 2.5) +
      ' full-time analysts. Nobody staffs that, so in practice the queue is ' +
      'ignored and the control stops working.</div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp-t"">Scoring, then alerting on the score</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp-bar""><div class=""fco-cmp-f good"" style=""width:' +
      Math.max(alPct * 100, 0.6).toFixed(1) + '%""></div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp-v"">' + full(al) + ' <span>' + pct(alPct, 2) +
      ' of transactions</span></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp-n"">About ' + Math.round(al / 50000 / 2.5) +
      ' analysts. A queue this size can actually be worked, which is the only ' +
      'reason the numbers on the other pages mean anything.</div></div></div>';
  }

  function gSection(id) {
    var m = D.meta || {};
    var h = '';

    if (id === 'start') {
      h += '<p class=""fco-lede"">This pack monitors <b>' + full(m.txns || 0) +
        '</b> card and account transactions for financial crime, across <b>' +
        esc(m.months || 0) + ' months</b> from ' + esc(m.minYr || '') + ' to ' +
        esc(m.maxYr || '') + '. It exists to answer one operational question: ' +
        'which transactions should a human look at today, and can the team ' +
        'actually work that many.</p>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-stats"">' +
        gstat(full(m.txns || 0), 'transactions') +
        gstat(full(m.customers || 0), 'customers') +
        gstat(full(m.alerts || 0), 'alerts raised') +
        gstat(esc(m.nRules || 0), 'scoring rules') +
        gstat(money(m.amt || 0), 'total value') +
        gstat(pct(m.txns ? (m.alerts || 0) / m.txns : 0), 'alert rate') +
        '</div>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>What makes this report unusual</h3>' +
        '<p>Every page is a <b>single visual</b>. Not a canvas of twenty ' +
        'visuals: one HTML visual filling the page, drawn by JavaScript from ' +
        'data one DAX measure hands it.</p>' +
        '<p>That sounds like a stunt and is not. A custom visual cannot ' +
        'cross-filter its neighbours unless its own compiled code builds ' +
        'selection identities, which this one does not. Rather than fight that, ' +
        'the page <i>is</i> the visual, so there is nothing to cross-filter to. ' +
        'Every click re-aggregates in the browser in under a millisecond and ' +
        'never touches the model.</p>' +
        '<p>Open <b>How the data gets here</b> next, or jump to ' +
        '<b>Firing vs alert</b> for the one idea that matters most.</p></div>';
      return h;
    }

    if (id === 'pipeline') {
      h += '<p class=""fco-lede"">Five stages, each deliberately constrained so ' +
        'the next one has something honest to do. Select a stage.</p>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-pipe"">';
      var cur = S.gstage == null ? 0 : S.gstage;
      for (var i = 0; i < GSTAGES.length; i++) {
        h += '<div class=""fco-stage' + (i === cur ? ' on' : '') +
          '"" data-k=""gstage"" data-v=""' + i + '"">' +
          '<div class=""fco-stage-n"">' + (i + 1) + '</div>' +
          '<div class=""fco-stage-t"">' + esc(GSTAGES[i][0]) + '</div>' +

      h += '</div>';
      var st = GSTAGES[S.gstage == null ? 0 : S.gstage];
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>' + esc(st[0]) + ' ' + DOT + ' ' +
        esc(st[1]) + '</h3><p>' + st[2] + '</p></div>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>Why the measure ships a cube</h3>' +
        '<p>A DAX measure holds roughly <b>2,100,000 characters</b>. Shipping ' +
        full(m.txns || 0) + ' rows at grain would need about <b>1.7 billion</b>, ' +
        'roughly 800 times over.</p>' +
        '<p>So each measure aggregates first and ships a small cube: the ' +
        'Overview uses month x channel x risk band x transaction type, 2,508 ' +
        'populated cells, about 4% of the ceiling. The browser re-aggregates ' +
        'that cube on every click. The trade is explicit: you can slice on the ' +
        'dimensions a page ships and no others.</p></div>';
      return h;
    }

    if (id === 'alerts') {
      h += '<p class=""fco-lede"">This is the one idea worth reading twice. A ' +
        '<b>rule firing</b> contributes points to a transaction risk score. An ' +
        '<b>alert</b> is that score crossing a threshold. Treating the two as ' +
        'the same thing is the most common way a monitoring programme quietly ' +
        'stops working.</p>';
      h += gFiringVsAlert();
      h += gThresholdDemo();
      return h;
    }

    if (id === 'pages') {
      h += '<p class=""fco-lede"">Three analytics pages, each shipping its own ' +
        'cube at the grain its questions need.</p>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-cols2"">';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>Overview</h3>' +
        '<p>Alert volume and value over time, by channel, risk band and ' +
        'transaction type. Chips filter all four dimensions at once, and ' +
        'clicking a month bar filters to it. Start here.</p>' +
        '<p class=""fco-dim"">Cube: month x channel x band x type</p></div>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>Rule effectiveness</h3>' +
        '<p>Which rules fire and how often, how many fire together on one ' +
        'transaction, the full score distribution, and a table pricing each ' +
        'cut-off in analyst headcount.</p>' +
        '<p class=""fco-dim"">Cubes: rules, rules-fired x band, score histogram</p>' +
        '</div>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>Risk and exposure</h3>' +
        '<p>Where risk concentrates: merchant category, settlement currency, ' +
        'card brand and entry mode, each stacked by risk band, with ' +
        'card-not-present, cross-border and odd-hour headlines.</p>' +
        '<p class=""fco-dim"">Cubes: four dimension x band grids</p></div>';
      h += '</div>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>How filtering behaves</h3>' +
        '<p>The chips at the top of a page filter <b>inside the browser</b>. ' +
        'They are instant and never hit the model.</p>' +
        '<p>Power BI report and page filters still apply, because the measure ' +
        'is evaluated in filter context. What a page cannot do is filter ' +
        '<b>out</b> to other visuals: an HTML visual receives filter context but ' +
        'cannot emit it. Use the page tabs to move between pages.</p></div>';
      return h;
    }

    if (id === 'numbers') {
      h += '<p class=""fco-lede"">Four conventions worth knowing before you quote ' +
        'anything off these pages.</p>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-cols2"">';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>Money crosses as integers</h3>' +
        '<p>Amounts leave DAX as <b>integer sen</b> and are divided by 100 in ' +
        'the browser. <code>FORMAT(x, ""0"")</code> emits no digit separator in ' +

        'silently corrupt the payload into invalid JavaScript.</p></div>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>Denominators differ on purpose</h3>' +
        '<p><b>Approval rate</b> and <b>decline rate</b> divide by the <b>' +
        full(m.decided || 0) + '</b> transactions that received an ' +
        'authorisation decision, not by all ' + full(m.txns || 0) + '. The ' +
        'other <b>' + full(m.undecided || 0) + '</b> never got one, and ' +
        'including them understates approval by about seven points.</p></div>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>Counts are exact</h3>' +
        '<p>Nothing here is sampled or estimated. Every figure reconciles to ' +
        'the model measures to the cent, and the build refuses to ship if the ' +
        'cube and the model disagree on a single cell.</p></div>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>Headcount is an assumption</h3>' +
        '<p>Analyst counts assume <b>50,000 alerts cleared per analyst-year</b> ' +

    if (id === 'quality') {
      h += '<p class=""fco-lede"">The source is deliberately ungoverned, and the ' +

      h += '<div class=""fco-cols2"">';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>What the source looked like</h3>' +
        '<p>100 columns, all text. Five competing date formats in one column, ' +
        'sentinel dates like <code>9999-12-31</code>, money as ' +
        '<code>1,234.50</code> and <code>(45.00)</code> and ' +
        '<code>RM99.00</code>, null written eight different ways, and <b>' +
        full(m.dupes || 0) + '</b> exact duplicate rows.</p></div>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>What cleaning recovered</h3>' +
        '<p>Posting dates went from <b>47.5%</b> parseable to <b>93.0%</b>. ' +
        'Country collapsed from 32 spellings to one code, KYC status from 11 ' +
        'variants to 5, card brand from 44 to 5.</p></div>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>What did not survive</h3>' +
        '<p><b>' + full(m.unknownDates || 0) + '</b> transactions have a date ' +

      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>Mess you can still see</h3>' +
        '<p>Currency holds both <code>MYR</code> and <code>RM</code> for the ' +

        '<code>458</code>. Risk and exposure treats both ringgit spellings as ' +
        'domestic and reports the unresolvable values separately instead of ' +
        'folding them into a headline.</p></div>';
      h += '</div>';
      return h;
    }

    // limits
    h += '<p class=""fco-lede"">Stated plainly, because a technique that hides ' +
      'its costs is being sold rather than explained.</p>';
    h += '<div class=""fco-cols2"">';
    h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>Fixed slicing grain</h3>' +
      '<p>Each page ships a cube at one grain, so you can slice on the ' +
      'dimensions shown and no others. Merchant has <b>250,004</b> members: ' +
      'shipping it would blow the ceiling for a panel nobody could read, so ' +
      'merchant category is the grain instead.</p></div>';
    h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>No cross-filtering out</h3>' +
      '<p>A page receives filter context but cannot emit it. Clicking a bar ' +
      'here will never drive a visual elsewhere. If that is a requirement, ' +
      'Deneb binds real model fields and implements selection, at the cost of ' +
      'Vega-Lite grammar.</p></div>';
    h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>Export returns markup</h3>' +

    h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>Synthetic data</h3>' +

  function kpi(label, value, note) {

  /* =========================================================================
   * RULE EFFECTIVENESS
   * ====================================================================== */
  function renderRules() {
    var rules = (D.dim && D.dim.rules) || [];
    var fired = D.fired || [];
    var hist = D.hist || [];
    var m = D.meta || {};
    var nb = (D.dim.bands || ['LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH']).length;
    var i;

    var h = '<div class=""fco-hd"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-ttl"">Rule Effectiveness</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-sub"">what fires, how often, and what it costs</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-spacer""></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-scope""><b>' + full(m.firings || 0) + '</b> firings across <b>' +
      full(m.txnsWithRule || 0) + '</b> transactions</div></div>';

    var perTxn = m.txns ? (m.firings || 0) / m.txns : 0;
    var perAlert = m.alerts ? (m.firings || 0) / m.alerts : 0;
    var anyRate = m.txns ? (m.txnsWithRule || 0) / m.txns : 0;
    h += '<div class=""fco-kpi"">' +
      kpi('Rules active', String(rules.length), 'contributing to the score') +
      kpi('Rule firings', full(m.firings || 0), perTxn.toFixed(2) + ' per transaction') +
      leadKpi(pct(anyRate, 1), 'Transactions touched by a rule') +
      kpi('Alerts raised', full(m.alerts || 0), 'score reached HIGH') +
      kpi('Firings per alert', perAlert.toFixed(1), 'noise absorbed per work item') +
      kpi('Analyst years', ((m.alerts || 0) / 50000).toFixed(1), 'at 50,000 a year') +
      '</div>';

    h += '<div class=""fco-bd"" style=""grid-template-columns:1.25fr 1fr;' +
      'grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr"">';

    var maxF = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < rules.length; i++) { if (rules[i][3] > maxF) maxF = rules[i][3]; }
    h += '<div class=""fco-p"" style=""grid-row:1;grid-column:1"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-ph""><div class=""fco-pt"">Rules by firing volume</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-pn"">weight is the score contribution</div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-tb""><table><thead><tr><th>Rule</th><th>Weight</th>' +
      '<th>Firings</th><th>Share of txns</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
    for (i = 0; i < rules.length; i++) {
      var r = rules[i];
      var w = maxF ? (r[3] / maxF) * 100 : 0;
      h += '<tr><td class=""nm"" title=""' + esc(r[1]) + '"">' + esc(r[1]) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r[2]) + '</td>' +
        '<td><b>' + num(r[3]) + '</b></td>' +
        '<td style=""width:34%""><div class=""fco-rb"" style=""height:11px"">' +
        '<div class=""fco-rf"" style=""width:' + w.toFixed(1) +
        '%;background:var(--accent)""></div></div></td></tr>';
    }
    h += '</tbody></table></div></div>';

    var byN = [], maxN = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < fired.length; i += 3) {
      var n = fired[i], b = fired[i + 1], t = fired[i + 2];
      if (!byN[n]) byN[n] = [0, 0, 0];
      byN[n][b] = (byN[n][b] || 0) + t;
    }
    for (i = 0; i < byN.length; i++) {
      if (!byN[i]) { byN[i] = [0, 0, 0]; continue; }
      var tt = byN[i][0] + byN[i][1] + byN[i][2];
      if (tt > maxN) maxN = tt;
    }
    h += '<div class=""fco-p"" style=""grid-row:1;grid-column:2"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-ph""><div class=""fco-pt"">Rules firing together</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-pn"">stacked by resulting band</div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-rows spread"">';
    for (i = 0; i < byN.length; i++) {
      var row = byN[i];
      var rt = row[0] + row[1] + row[2];
      h += '<div class=""fco-row""><div class=""fco-rl"">' +
        (i === 0 ? 'none' : i + (i === 1 ? ' rule' : ' rules')) +
        '</div><div class=""fco-rb"">';
      for (var bb = 0; bb < nb; bb++) {
        var wv = maxN ? ((row[bb] || 0) / maxN) * 100 : 0;
        if (wv > 0) h += '<div class=""fco-rf s' + bb + '"" style=""width:' +
          wv.toFixed(2) + '%""></div>';
      }
      h += '</div><div class=""fco-rv"">' + num(rt) + '</div></div>';
    }
    h += '</div></div>';

    var maxH = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < hist.length; i += 2) { if (hist[i + 1] > maxH) maxH = hist[i + 1]; }
    var thr = m.threshold || 70;
    var nbk = hist.length / 2;
    h += '<div class=""fco-p"" style=""grid-row:2;grid-column:1"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-ph""><div class=""fco-pt"">Risk score distribution</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-pn"">bucketed by 5 ' + DOT +
      ' red line is the alert threshold</div></div><div class=""fco-hist"">';
    for (i = 0; i < hist.length; i += 2) {
      var bk = hist[i], cnt = hist[i + 1];
      var ph = maxH ? (cnt / maxH) * 100 : 0;
      var med = m.medThreshold || 30;
      var cls = bk >= thr ? ' h' : (bk >= med ? ' m' : '');
      h += '<div class=""fco-hb"" title=""score ' + bk + ' to ' + (bk + 4) + ': ' +
        full(cnt) + '""><div class=""fco-hf' + cls + '"" style=""height:' +
        ph.toFixed(2) + '%""></div>';
      if ((i / 2) % 4 === 0) { h += '<div class=""fco-hx"">' + bk + '</div>'; }
      h += '</div>';
    }
    if (nbk) {
      h += '<div class=""fco-thr"" data-l=""' + thr + '"" style=""left:' +
        ((thr / 5) / nbk * 100).toFixed(2) + '%""></div>';
    }
    h += '</div></div>';

    h += '<div class=""fco-p"" style=""grid-row:2;grid-column:2"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-ph""><div class=""fco-pt"">What a threshold costs</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-pn"">alerts above the cut-off</div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-tb""><table><thead><tr><th>Cut-off</th><th>Alerts</th>' +
      '<th>Rate</th><th>Analysts</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
    var cuts = [40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90];
    for (var c = 0; c < cuts.length; c++) {
      var cut = cuts[c], al = 0;
      for (i = 0; i < hist.length; i += 2) { if (hist[i] >= cut) al += hist[i + 1]; }
      var rate = m.txns ? al / m.txns : 0;
      var fte = (al / 50000) / 2.5;
      var on = (cut === thr);
      h += '<tr' + (on ? ' style=""background:var(--accent-weak)""' : '') +
        '><td class=""nm""' + (on ? ' style=""font-weight:680""' : '') + '>' + cut +
        (on ? ' (current)' : '') + '</td><td>' + num(al) + '</td><td>' +
        pct(rate, 2) + '</td><td><b>' + fte.toFixed(0) + '</b></td></tr>';
    }
    h += '</tbody></table><div class=""fco-pn"" style=""margin-top:7px;margin-left:0"">' +
      'Analysts assumes 50,000 alerts cleared per analyst-year across the period. ' +
      'Moving the cut-off is a staffing decision, not a preference.</div></div></div>';

    return h + '</div>';
  }

  /* =========================================================================
   * RISK AND EXPOSURE
   * ====================================================================== */
  function renderRisk() {
    var m = D.meta || {};
    var nb = (D.dim.bands || ['LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH']).length;

    function panel(title, note, rows, labels, row1, col1, fmtv) {
      var agg = [], max = 0, i;
      for (i = 0; i < rows.length; i += 4) {
        var k = rows[i], b = rows[i + 1], t = rows[i + 2], a = rows[i + 3];
        if (!agg[k]) agg[k] = { t: 0, a: 0, b: [0, 0, 0] };
        agg[k].t += t; agg[k].a += a; agg[k].b[b] = (agg[k].b[b] || 0) + t;
      }
      var order = [];
      for (i = 0; i < agg.length; i++) { if (agg[i]) order.push(i); }
      order.sort(function (x, y) { return agg[y].t - agg[x].t; });
      for (i = 0; i < order.length; i++) {
        if (agg[order[i]].t > max) max = agg[order[i]].t;
      }
      var h = '<div class=""fco-p"" style=""grid-row:' + row1 + ';grid-column:' +
        col1 + '""><div class=""fco-ph""><div class=""fco-pt"">' + esc(title) + '</div>' +
        '<div class=""fco-pn"">' + esc(note) + '</div></div>' +
        '<div class=""fco-rows' + (order.length <= 9 ? ' spread' : '') + '"">';
      for (i = 0; i < order.length && i < 14; i++) {
        var k2 = order[i], g = agg[k2];
        var lab = labels[k2] == null ? '?' : labels[k2];
        h += '<div class=""fco-row""><div class=""fco-rl"" title=""' + esc(lab) + '"">' +
          esc(lab) + '</div><div class=""fco-rb"">';
        for (var b2 = 0; b2 < nb; b2++) {
          var w = max ? ((g.b[b2] || 0) / max) * 100 : 0;
          if (w > 0) h += '<div class=""fco-rf s' + b2 + '"" style=""width:' +
            w.toFixed(2) + '%""></div>';
        }
        h += '</div><div class=""fco-rv"">' +
          (fmtv === 'money' ? money(g.a) : num(g.t)) + '</div></div>';
      }
      return h + '</div></div>';
    }

    var cnpRate = m.txns ? (m.cnpTxns || 0) / m.txns : 0;
    var xbRate = m.amt ? (m.crossBorderAmt || 0) / m.amt : 0;
    var oddRate = m.txns ? (m.oddHourTxns || 0) / m.txns : 0;
    // Over transactions that received a decision, not all of them, for the
    // same reason as approval rate on the Overview.
    var decRate = m.decided ? (m.declined || 0) / m.decided : 0;

    var h = '<div class=""fco-hd"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-ttl"">Risk and Exposure</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-sub"">where the risk concentrates</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-spacer""></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-scope"">exposure at risk <b>' + money(m.exposure || 0) +
      '</b> of ' + money(m.amt || 0) +
      (m.unknownCcyAmt ? ' ' + DOT + ' ' + money(m.unknownCcyAmt) +
        ' in unresolvable currencies' : '') + '</div></div>';

    h += '<div class=""fco-kpi"">' +
      kpi('Exposure at risk', money(m.exposure || 0), 'value behind the HIGH band') +
      kpi('Card not present', pct(cnpRate, 1), full(m.cnpTxns || 0) + ' transactions') +
      leadKpi(pct(xbRate, 1), 'Value settled in a foreign currency') +
      kpi('Odd hour', pct(oddRate, 1), 'outside 06:00 to 22:00') +
      kpi('Declined', pct(decRate, 1), 'of ' + full(m.decided || 0) + ' decided') +
      kpi('Mean risk score', (m.meanScore || 0).toFixed(1), 'of a possible 145') +
      '</div>';

    h += '<div class=""fco-bd"" style=""grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;' +
      'grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr"">';
    h += panel('Merchant category', 'stacked by risk band, by volume',
               D.mcc || [], D.dim.mccs || [], 1, 1);
    h += panel('Currency', 'value settled', D.ccy || [], D.dim.ccys || [],
               1, 2, 'money');
    h += panel('Card brand', 'stacked by risk band', D.brand || [],
               D.dim.brands || [], 2, 1);
    h += panel('Entry mode', 'how the card was presented', D.entry || [],
               D.dim.entries || [], 2, 2);
    return h + '</div>';
  }

  /* =========================================================================
   * INTERACTION
   * Listeners are delegated onto the root and wired ONCE per root element.
   * Wiring per render stacks handlers, and two handlers make a toggle fire
   * twice and net to no change, which is the classic ""it needs a refresh"" bug.
   * ====================================================================== */
  function wire() {
    if (wired === root) return;
    wired = root;
    root.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var el = closest(e.target, '[data-k]');
      if (!el) return;
      var k = el.getAttribute('data-k');
      var i = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-i'), 10);

      if (k === 'reset') {
        S.ch = {}; S.bd = {}; S.tp = {}; S.m0 = S.m1 = null;
        // deliberately leaves gsec/gstage/gthr alone: clearing data
        // filters should not throw the reader out of the guide.
        return schedule();
      }
      if (k === 'gsec') {
        S.gsec = el.getAttribute('data-v');
        return schedule();
      }
      if (k === 'gstage') {
        S.gstage = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-v'), 10);
        return schedule();
      }
      if (k === 'gthr') {
        S.gthr = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-v'), 10);
        return schedule();
      }
      if (k === 'ch' || k === 'bd' || k === 'tp') {
        toggle(S[k], i);
        return schedule();
      }
      if (k === 'm') {
        if (e.shiftKey && S.m0 != null) {
          S.m1 = i;
        } else if (S.m0 === i && S.m1 === i) {
          S.m0 = S.m1 = null;           // clicking the only selected month clears
        } else {
          S.m0 = S.m1 = i;
        }
        return schedule();
      }
    });
  }

  /* =========================================================================
   * BOOT
   * ====================================================================== */
  function ensureStyles() {
    if (document.getElementById('fco-css')) return;
    var s = document.createElement('style');
    s.id = 'fco-css';
    s.appendChild(document.createTextNode(CSS));
    (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(s);
  }
  function ensureRoot() {
    var c = document.getElementById('fco-root') || document.querySelector('[data-fco-root]');
    if (!c) {
      c = document.createElement('div');
      c.id = 'fco-root';
      (document.body || document.documentElement).appendChild(c);
    }
    return c;
  }

  var pending = false, tries = 0, timer = null, rendered = false;
  function schedule() {
    if (pending) return;
    pending = true;
    var run = function () {
      pending = false;
      try { ensureStyles(); render(); rendered = true; } catch (err) { fail(err); }
    };
    if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') requestAnimationFrame(run);
    else setTimeout(run, 0);
  }
  function boot() { if (timer) clearTimeout(timer); tries = 0; attempt(); }
  function attempt() {
    if (!document.body) { if (tries++ < 200) timer = setTimeout(attempt, 16); return; }
    // Load order is not guaranteed: the inline payload script may run before or
    // after this file. Give it a few frames before drawing the empty state.
    if (!window.__fcData && !window.FC_FIXTURE && !rendered && tries < 12 &&
        document.readyState !== 'complete') {
      tries++; timer = setTimeout(attempt, 24); return;
    }
    schedule();
  }
  function fail(e) {
    try {
      var r = ensureRoot();
      r.className = 'fco';
      r.innerHTML = '<div class=""fco-err""><b>Financial Crime Overview failed to render.</b><br>v' +
        VERSION + ' ' + DOT + ' ' + esc(e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)) + '</div>';
      if (window.console && console.error) console.error('[fco]', e);
    } catch (x) { /* nothing left to do */ }
  }

  window.FCO = {
    __installed: VERSION, version: VERSION,
    boot: boot, render: schedule, state: S,
    _dbg: function () { return { D: D, scan: scan }; }
  };
  boot();
})();
"

RETURN
    "<div id='fco-root'></div>"
        & "<script>" & Payload
        & "if(window.FCO&&window.FCO.render){window.FCO.render();}"
        & "</script>"
        & "<script>" & Lib & "</script>"

measures.name: Risk and Exposure
measures.expression:
VAR BS = UNICHAR ( 92 )

VAR BandsIdx =
    SELECTCOLUMNS (
        { ( "LOW", 0 ), ( "MEDIUM", 1 ), ( "HIGH", 2 ) },
        "lbl", [Value1],
        "idx", [Value2]
    )

// -- dimension member lists, index order fixed here --------------------------
VAR MccList =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        SUMMARIZE ( ALL ( dim_merchant ), dim_merchant[merchant_mcc] ),
        "lbl", COALESCE ( dim_merchant[merchant_mcc], "(blank)" )
    )
VAR Mccs = SUMMARIZE ( MccList, [lbl] )
VAR MccIdx = ADDCOLUMNS ( Mccs, "idx", RANKX ( Mccs, [lbl], , ASC, DENSE ) - 1 )

VAR CcyList =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        SUMMARIZE ( ALL ( fact_transaction ), fact_transaction[txn_currency] ),
        "lbl", COALESCE ( fact_transaction[txn_currency], "(blank)" )
    )
VAR Ccys = SUMMARIZE ( CcyList, [lbl] )
VAR CcyIdx = ADDCOLUMNS ( Ccys, "idx", RANKX ( Ccys, [lbl], , ASC, DENSE ) - 1 )

VAR BrandList =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        SUMMARIZE ( ALL ( dim_card ), dim_card[card_brand] ),
        "lbl", COALESCE ( dim_card[card_brand], "(blank)" )
    )
VAR Brands = SUMMARIZE ( BrandList, [lbl] )
VAR BrandIdx = ADDCOLUMNS ( Brands, "idx", RANKX ( Brands, [lbl], , ASC, DENSE ) - 1 )

VAR EntryList =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        SUMMARIZE ( ALL ( dim_channel ), dim_channel[entry_mode] ),
        "lbl", COALESCE ( dim_channel[entry_mode], "(blank)" )
    )
VAR Entries = SUMMARIZE ( EntryList, [lbl] )
VAR EntryIdx = ADDCOLUMNS ( Entries, "idx", RANKX ( Entries, [lbl], , ASC, DENSE ) - 1 )

// -- the four cubes ----------------------------------------------------------
VAR MccRows =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        SUMMARIZE ( fact_transaction, dim_merchant[merchant_mcc],
                    fact_transaction[risk_band] ),
        "txns", [Transactions],
        "amt", ROUND ( CALCULATE ( SUM ( fact_transaction[txn_amount] ) ) * 100, 0 )
    )
VAR MccJs =
    CONCATENATEX (
        FILTER ( MccRows, [txns] > 0 ),
        VAR _l = COALESCE ( dim_merchant[merchant_mcc], "(blank)" )
        VAR _b = COALESCE ( fact_transaction[risk_band], "(blank)" )
        RETURN
            FORMAT ( COALESCE ( MAXX ( FILTER ( MccIdx, [lbl] = _l ), [idx] ), 0 ), "0" ) & ","
                & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( MAXX ( FILTER ( BandsIdx, [lbl] = _b ), [idx] ), 0 ), "0" ) & ","
                & FORMAT ( [txns], "0" ) & ","
                & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( [amt], 0 ), "0" ),
        ","
    )

VAR CcyRows =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        SUMMARIZE ( fact_transaction, fact_transaction[txn_currency],
                    fact_transaction[risk_band] ),
        "txns", [Transactions],
        "amt", ROUND ( CALCULATE ( SUM ( fact_transaction[txn_amount] ) ) * 100, 0 )
    )
VAR CcyJs =
    CONCATENATEX (
        FILTER ( CcyRows, [txns] > 0 ),
        VAR _l = COALESCE ( fact_transaction[txn_currency], "(blank)" )
        VAR _b = COALESCE ( fact_transaction[risk_band], "(blank)" )
        RETURN
            FORMAT ( COALESCE ( MAXX ( FILTER ( CcyIdx, [lbl] = _l ), [idx] ), 0 ), "0" ) & ","
                & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( MAXX ( FILTER ( BandsIdx, [lbl] = _b ), [idx] ), 0 ), "0" ) & ","
                & FORMAT ( [txns], "0" ) & ","
                & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( [amt], 0 ), "0" ),
        ","
    )

VAR BrandRows =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        SUMMARIZE ( fact_transaction, dim_card[card_brand],
                    fact_transaction[risk_band] ),
        "txns", [Transactions],
        "amt", ROUND ( CALCULATE ( SUM ( fact_transaction[txn_amount] ) ) * 100, 0 )
    )
VAR BrandJs =
    CONCATENATEX (
        FILTER ( BrandRows, [txns] > 0 ),
        VAR _l = COALESCE ( dim_card[card_brand], "(blank)" )
        VAR _b = COALESCE ( fact_transaction[risk_band], "(blank)" )
        RETURN
            FORMAT ( COALESCE ( MAXX ( FILTER ( BrandIdx, [lbl] = _l ), [idx] ), 0 ), "0" ) & ","
                & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( MAXX ( FILTER ( BandsIdx, [lbl] = _b ), [idx] ), 0 ), "0" ) & ","
                & FORMAT ( [txns], "0" ) & ","
                & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( [amt], 0 ), "0" ),
        ","
    )

VAR EntryRows =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        SUMMARIZE ( fact_transaction, dim_channel[entry_mode],
                    fact_transaction[risk_band] ),
        "txns", [Transactions],
        "amt", ROUND ( CALCULATE ( SUM ( fact_transaction[txn_amount] ) ) * 100, 0 )
    )
VAR EntryJs =
    CONCATENATEX (
        FILTER ( EntryRows, [txns] > 0 ),
        VAR _l = COALESCE ( dim_channel[entry_mode], "(blank)" )
        VAR _b = COALESCE ( fact_transaction[risk_band], "(blank)" )
        RETURN
            FORMAT ( COALESCE ( MAXX ( FILTER ( EntryIdx, [lbl] = _l ), [idx] ), 0 ), "0" ) & ","
                & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( MAXX ( FILTER ( BandsIdx, [lbl] = _b ), [idx] ), 0 ), "0" ) & ","
                & FORMAT ( [txns], "0" ) & ","
                & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( [amt], 0 ), "0" ),
        ","
    )

VAR LabelsJs =
    "mccs:[" & CONCATENATEX ( MccIdx, "'" & SUBSTITUTE ( [lbl], "'", BS & "'" ) & "'",
                              ",", [idx], ASC ) & "],"
        & "ccys:[" & CONCATENATEX ( CcyIdx, "'" & SUBSTITUTE ( [lbl], "'", BS & "'" ) & "'",
                                    ",", [idx], ASC ) & "],"
        & "brands:[" & CONCATENATEX ( BrandIdx, "'" & SUBSTITUTE ( [lbl], "'", BS & "'" ) & "'",
                                      ",", [idx], ASC ) & "],"
        & "entries:[" & CONCATENATEX ( EntryIdx, "'" & SUBSTITUTE ( [lbl], "'", BS & "'" ) & "'",
                                       ",", [idx], ASC ) & "]"

// -- headline figures --------------------------------------------------------
VAR TotTxns = CALCULATE ( [Transactions], ALLSELECTED () )
VAR TotAmt = CALCULATE ( ROUND ( [Total Amount] * 100, 0 ), ALLSELECTED () )
VAR TotExp = CALCULATE ( ROUND ( [Exposure at Risk] * 100, 0 ), ALLSELECTED () )
VAR CnpTxns =
    CALCULATE ( [Transactions], ALLSELECTED (), dim_channel[is_card_not_present] = TRUE () )
// The currency column was never fully conformed: Malaysian ringgit appears as
// both "MYR" and "RM", and there are "NA", "#N/A" and a numeric "458" in there
// too. Testing <> "MYR" alone therefore books every "RM" transaction as
// cross-border and overstates it. Both spellings count as domestic; the
// unresolvable values are reported separately rather than guessed at.
VAR DomesticCcy = { "MYR", "RM" }
VAR XbAmt =
    CALCULATE (
        ROUND ( [Total Amount] * 100, 0 ),
        ALLSELECTED (),
        NOT ( fact_transaction[txn_currency] IN DomesticCcy ),
        NOT ISBLANK ( fact_transaction[txn_currency] )
    )
VAR UnknownCcyAmt =
    CALCULATE (
        ROUND ( [Total Amount] * 100, 0 ),
        ALLSELECTED (),
        fact_transaction[txn_currency] IN { "NA", "#N/A", "N/A", "NULL", "-" }
    )
VAR OddTxns =
    CALCULATE ( [Transactions], ALLSELECTED (), dim_time[is_odd_hour] = TRUE () )
// In DAX, BLANK() = FALSE() is TRUE. Writing `auth_approved = FALSE()` therefore
// counts every transaction that never received a decision as a decline, which
// reported 33,440,758 declines where the real figure is 24,580,346. The blank
// has to be excluded explicitly.
VAR Declined =
    CALCULATE (
        [Transactions],
        ALLSELECTED (),
        NOT ISBLANK ( fact_transaction[auth_approved] ),
        fact_transaction[auth_approved] = FALSE ()
    )
VAR DecidedTot =
    CALCULATE ( [Transactions], ALLSELECTED (),
                NOT ISBLANK ( fact_transaction[auth_approved] ) )
VAR MeanScore = CALCULATE ( AVERAGE ( fact_transaction[risk_score] ), ALLSELECTED () )

VAR Payload =
    "window.__fcData={page:'risk',currency:'RM',dim:{"
        & "bands:['LOW','MEDIUM','HIGH'],"
        & LabelsJs & "},"
        & "mcc:[" & MccJs & "],"
        & "ccy:[" & CcyJs & "],"
        & "brand:[" & BrandJs & "],"
        & "entry:[" & EntryJs & "],"
        & "meta:{"
            & "txns:" & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( TotTxns, 0 ), "0" )
            & ",amt:" & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( TotAmt, 0 ), "0" )
            & ",exposure:" & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( TotExp, 0 ), "0" )
            & ",cnpTxns:" & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( CnpTxns, 0 ), "0" )
            & ",crossBorderAmt:" & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( XbAmt, 0 ), "0" )
            & ",oddHourTxns:" & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( OddTxns, 0 ), "0" )
            & ",declined:" & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( Declined, 0 ), "0" )
            & ",decided:" & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( DecidedTot, 0 ), "0" )
            & ",unknownCcyAmt:" & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( UnknownCcyAmt, 0 ), "0" )
            & ",meanScore:" & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( MeanScore, 0 ), "0.00" )
        & "}};"

VAR Lib = "(function () {
  'use strict';

  var VERSION = '1.0.0';

  if (window.FCO && window.FCO.__installed === VERSION && typeof window.FCO.boot === 'function') {
    window.FCO.boot();
    return;
  }

  var STRIDE = 8;
  var DOT = '·';

  /* =========================================================================
   * STYLES
   * The palette is the fincrime console's own: sage cream ground, leaf green
   * accent, OKLCH throughout. Deliberately not the navy-and-gold that every
   * financial crime dashboard reaches for first.
   * ====================================================================== */
  var CSS = [
    '.fco{',
    '--ground:oklch(.975 .022 130);--surface:oklch(1 0 0);--sunken:oklch(.955 .028 130);',
    '--ink:oklch(.22 .025 135);--ink2:oklch(.48 .02 135);--ink3:oklch(.62 .015 135);',
    '--line:oklch(.88 .02 130);--line2:oklch(.78 .022 130);',
    '--accent:oklch(.58 .22 140);--accent-weak:oklch(.92 .07 140);',
    '--low:oklch(.72 .07 145);--med:oklch(.70 .13 75);--high:oklch(.55 .19 27);',
    '--crit:oklch(.50 .20 27);--good:oklch(.50 .16 145);',
    '--ease:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);',
    '}',
    '.fco *{margin:0;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:inherit;',

    ""font-family:'Segoe UI',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Arial,sans-serif;"",

    '-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}',

    /* header ------------------------------------------------------------- */
    '.fco-hd{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;',

    'text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;}',

    /* KPI strip: one continuous band, not a grid of identical cards ------- */
    '.fco-kpi{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:stretch;background:var(--surface);',

    '.fco-k{padding:12px 20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;',

    /* horizontal bar list ------------------------------------------------ */

    '.fco-rl{font-size:11.5px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;',

    /* rules table -------------------------------------------------------- */

  /* =========================================================================
   * STATE
   * On a window global, because the visual's iframe has a null origin and
   * localStorage throws there. Survives the DOM being replaced on cross-filter.
   * ====================================================================== */
  var S = window.__fcState || (window.__fcState = {
    ch: {}, bd: {}, tp: {}, m0: null, m1: null,
    gsec: 'start', gstage: 0, gthr: null
  });

  var D = null, root = null, wired = null;

  /* =========================================================================
   * HELPERS
   * ====================================================================== */
  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s)
      .replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>')
      .replace(/""/g, '"').replace(/'/g, ''');
  }
  function closest(el, sel) {
    while (el && el.nodeType === 1) {
      if (el.matches ? el.matches(sel) : false) return el;
      el = el.parentNode;
    }
    return null;
  }
  function anyOn(o) { for (var k in o) { if (o[k]) return true; } return false; }
  function isOn(o, i) { return !anyOn(o) || !!o[i]; }
  function toggle(o, k) { if (o[k]) { delete o[k]; } else { o[k] = true; } }

  function num(n) {
    if (n == null || !isFinite(n)) return '-';
    var a = Math.abs(n);
    if (a >= 1e9) return (n / 1e9).toFixed(a >= 1e10 ? 0 : 1) + 'b';
    if (a >= 1e6) return (n / 1e6).toFixed(a >= 1e7 ? 0 : 1) + 'm';
    if (a >= 1e3) return (n / 1e3).toFixed(a >= 1e4 ? 0 : 1) + 'k';
    return String(Math.round(n));
  }
  function full(n) {
    if (n == null || !isFinite(n)) return '-';
    return Math.round(n).toString().replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
  }
  // Money arrives in sen. Divide once, here, and never anywhere else.
  function money(minor) {
    if (minor == null || !isFinite(minor)) return '-';
    return (D.currency || 'RM') + ' ' + num(minor / 100);
  }
  function pct(x, dp) {
    if (x == null || !isFinite(x)) return '-';
    return (x * 100).toFixed(dp == null ? 2 : dp) + '%';
  }

  /* =========================================================================
   * AGGREGATION
   * One pass over the cube per render. 2,508 cells is nothing; this is
   * sub-millisecond and is why every click feels instant.
   * ====================================================================== */
  function scan(opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    var c = D.cube, n = c.length;
    var skipM = !!opts.allMonths, skipC = !!opts.allChannels;
    var skipB = !!opts.allBands, skipT = !!opts.allTypes;

    var out = {
      txns: 0, amt: 0, appr: 0, dec: 0, alerts: 0, alertAmt: 0,
      byMonth: [], byChan: [], byBand: [], byType: [],
      byMonthBand: [], byChanBand: []
    };
    var nm = D.dim.months.length, nc = D.dim.channels.length,
        nb = D.dim.bands.length, nt = D.dim.types.length;
    var i;
    for (i = 0; i < nm; i++) { out.byMonth[i] = 0; }
    for (i = 0; i < nc; i++) { out.byChan[i] = 0; }
    for (i = 0; i < nb; i++) { out.byBand[i] = 0; }
    for (i = 0; i < nt; i++) { out.byType[i] = 0; }
    for (i = 0; i < nm * nb; i++) { out.byMonthBand[i] = 0; }
    for (i = 0; i < nc * nb; i++) { out.byChanBand[i] = 0; }

    var hiIdx = D.dim.bands.indexOf('HIGH');

    for (i = 0; i < n; i += STRIDE) {
      var mi = c[i], ci = c[i + 1], bi = c[i + 2], ti = c[i + 3];
      if (!skipM && !monthIn(mi)) continue;
      if (!skipC && !isOn(S.ch, ci)) continue;
      if (!skipB && !isOn(S.bd, bi)) continue;
      if (!skipT && !isOn(S.tp, ti)) continue;

      var t = c[i + 4], a = c[i + 5], ap = c[i + 6], dc = c[i + 7];
      out.txns += t; out.amt += a; out.appr += ap; out.dec += dc;
      if (bi === hiIdx) { out.alerts += t; out.alertAmt += a; }
      out.byMonth[mi] += t;
      out.byChan[ci] += t;
      out.byBand[bi] += t;
      out.byType[ti] += t;
      out.byMonthBand[mi * nb + bi] += t;
      out.byChanBand[ci * nb + bi] += t;
    }
    return out;
  }

  function monthIn(mi) {
    if (S.m0 == null || S.m1 == null) return true;
    var lo = Math.min(S.m0, S.m1), hi = Math.max(S.m0, S.m1);
    return mi >= lo && mi <= hi;
  }

  /* =========================================================================
   * RENDER
   * ====================================================================== */
  function render() {
    D = window.__fcData || window.FC_FIXTURE;
    root = ensureRoot();
    if (!D || !D.dim) {
      root.className = 'fco';
      root.innerHTML = '<div class=""fco-err"">Waiting for data. The measure did not supply <code>window.__fcData</code>.</div>';
      return;
    }

    root.className = 'fco';
    var page = D.page || 'overview';

    if (page === 'guide') {
      root.innerHTML = renderGuide();
      wire();
      return;
    }
    if (page === 'rules') {
      root.innerHTML = renderRules();
      wire();
      return;
    }
    if (page === 'risk') {
      root.innerHTML = renderRisk();
      wire();
      return;
    }

    var A = scan();
    var nb = D.dim.bands.length;

    root.innerHTML =
      header(A) + filters() + kpis(A) +
      '<div class=""fco-bd"">' +
        panelTrend(A, nb) +
        panelChannel(A, nb) +
        panelSplit(A) +
        panelRules() +
      '</div>';

    wire();
  }

  function header(A) {
    var T = D.totals || {};
    var pctShown = T.txns ? A.txns / T.txns : 1;
    return '<div class=""fco-hd"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-ttl"">Financial Crime Overview</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-sub"">transaction monitoring ' + DOT + ' ' +
        esc(D.dim.months.length) + ' months</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-spacer""></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-scope""><b>' + full(A.txns) + '</b> of ' + full(T.txns || A.txns) +
        ' transactions in scope (' + pct(pctShown, 1) + ')</div>' +
      '</div>';
  }

  function filters() {
    var h = '<div class=""fco-flt"">';
    h += '<div class=""fco-grp""><span class=""fco-lbl"">Risk</span>';
    for (var b = 0; b < D.dim.bands.length; b++) {
      h += '<span class=""fco-chip b' + b + (S.bd[b] ? ' on' : '') +
        '"" data-k=""bd"" data-i=""' + b + '"">' + esc(D.dim.bands[b]) + '</span>';
    }
    h += '</div>';

    h += '<div class=""fco-grp""><span class=""fco-lbl"">Channel</span>';
    for (var c = 0; c < D.dim.channels.length; c++) {
      h += '<span class=""fco-chip' + (S.ch[c] ? ' on' : '') +
        '"" data-k=""ch"" data-i=""' + c + '"">' + esc(label(D.dim.channels[c])) + '</span>';
    }
    h += '</div>';

    h += '<div class=""fco-grp""><span class=""fco-lbl"">Type</span>';
    for (var t = 0; t < D.dim.types.length; t++) {
      h += '<span class=""fco-chip' + (S.tp[t] ? ' on' : '') +
        '"" data-k=""tp"" data-i=""' + t + '"">' + esc(label(D.dim.types[t])) + '</span>';
    }
    h += '</div>';

    var live = anyOn(S.ch) || anyOn(S.bd) || anyOn(S.tp) || S.m0 != null;
    if (live) h += '<span class=""fco-reset"" data-k=""reset"">Clear all filters</span>';
    return h + '</div>';
  }

  function label(s) {
    if (s == null || s === '' || s === '(blank)') return 'Blank';
    return String(s).replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\w\S*/g, function (w) {
      return w.charAt(0) + w.slice(1).toLowerCase();
    });
  }

  function kpis(A) {
    var rate = A.txns ? A.alerts / A.txns : 0;
    // Denominator is transactions that GOT a decision, matching the model's
    // [Approval Rate]. Dividing by every transaction silently understates it.
    var appr = A.dec ? A.appr / A.dec : 0;
    var years = A.alerts / 50000;
    var k = [
      ['Transactions', full(A.txns), money(A.amt) + ' total value'],
      ['Alerts raised', full(A.alerts), 'risk band HIGH'],
      ['LEAD', pct(rate), 'Alert rate'],
      ['Exposure at risk', money(A.alertAmt), 'value behind alerts'],
      ['Approval rate', pct(appr, 1), full(A.dec) + ' had a decision'],
      ['Analyst years', years.toFixed(1), 'at 50,000 alerts a year']
    ];
    var h = '<div class=""fco-kpi"">';
    for (var i = 0; i < k.length; i++) {
      if (k[i][0] === 'LEAD') {
        h += '<div class=""fco-k lead""><div class=""fco-kl"">' + esc(k[i][2]) + '</div>' +
          '<div class=""fco-kv"">' + esc(k[i][1]) + '</div>' +
          '<div class=""fco-kn"">share of transactions alerted</div></div>';
      } else {
        h += '<div class=""fco-k""><div class=""fco-kl"">' + esc(k[i][0]) + '</div>' +
          '<div class=""fco-kv"">' + esc(k[i][1]) + '</div>' +
          '<div class=""fco-kn"">' + esc(k[i][2]) + '</div></div>';
      }
    }
    return h + '</div>';
  }

  function panelTrend(A, nb) {
    // Months are scanned without the month filter so the brush shows context:
    // the bars you excluded stay visible, dimmed, instead of vanishing.
    var ctx = scan({ allMonths: true });
    var max = 0, i;
    for (i = 0; i < ctx.byMonth.length; i++) { if (ctx.byMonth[i] > max) max = ctx.byMonth[i]; }

    var h = '<div class=""fco-p"" style=""grid-row:1;grid-column:1"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-ph""><div class=""fco-pt"">Transactions by month</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-pn"">click a bar to filter ' + DOT + ' shift-click for a range</div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-tr"" data-k=""trend"">';

    for (i = 0; i < D.dim.months.length; i++) {
      var inR = monthIn(i);
      var tot = ctx.byMonth[i];
      h += '<div class=""fco-col' + (inR ? '' : ' dim') + '"" data-k=""m"" data-i=""' + i + '"" ' +
        'title=""' + esc(D.dim.months[i][1]) + ': ' + full(tot) + ' transactions"">';
      // Stack HIGH on top so the eye lands on it.
      for (var b = nb - 1; b >= 0; b--) {
        var v = ctx.byMonthBand[i * nb + b];
        var pxh = max ? (v / max) * 100 : 0;
        if (pxh > 0) {
          h += '<div class=""fco-seg s' + b + '"" style=""height:' + pxh.toFixed(2) + '%""></div>';
        }
      }
      var lab = D.dim.months[i][1];
      var isUnknown = D.dim.months[i][0] === 0;
      var show = isUnknown || (i % 4 === 0);
      h += '<div class=""fco-cx"">' +
        esc(show ? (isUnknown ? 'Unknown' : lab.replace(' 20', "" '"")) : '') + '</div>';
      h += '</div>';
    }
    return h + '</div></div>';
  }

  function panelChannel(A, nb) {
    var ctx = scan({ allChannels: true });
    var max = 0, i;
    for (i = 0; i < ctx.byChan.length; i++) { if (ctx.byChan[i] > max) max = ctx.byChan[i]; }

    var order = [];
    for (i = 0; i < D.dim.channels.length; i++) { order.push(i); }
    order.sort(function (a, b) { return ctx.byChan[b] - ctx.byChan[a]; });

    var h = '<div class=""fco-p"" style=""grid-row:1;grid-column:2"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-ph""><div class=""fco-pt"">Channel</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-pn"">stacked by risk band</div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-rows spread"">';
    for (var k = 0; k < order.length; k++) {
      var ci = order[k], tot = ctx.byChan[ci];
      var on = isOn(S.ch, ci);
      h += '<div class=""fco-row' + (on ? '' : ' dim') + '"" data-k=""ch"" data-i=""' + ci + '"">' +
        '<div class=""fco-rl"">' + esc(label(D.dim.channels[ci])) + '</div><div class=""fco-rb"">';
      for (var b = 0; b < nb; b++) {
        var v = ctx.byChanBand[ci * nb + b];
        var w = max ? (v / max) * 100 : 0;
        if (w > 0) h += '<div class=""fco-rf s' + b + '"" style=""width:' + w.toFixed(2) + '%""></div>';
      }
      h += '</div><div class=""fco-rv"">' + num(tot) + '</div></div>';
    }
    return h + '</div></div>';
  }

  function panelSplit(A) {
    var nb = D.dim.bands.length;
    var h = '<div class=""fco-p"" style=""grid-row:2;grid-column:1"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-ph""><div class=""fco-pt"">Composition</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-pn"">within the current filter</div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-rows"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-gh"">By risk band, share of transactions</div>';

    var maxB = 0, i;
    for (i = 0; i < nb; i++) { if (A.byBand[i] > maxB) maxB = A.byBand[i]; }
    for (i = 0; i < nb; i++) {
      var w = maxB ? (A.byBand[i] / maxB) * 100 : 0;
      var share = A.txns ? A.byBand[i] / A.txns : 0;
      h += '<div class=""fco-row' + (isOn(S.bd, i) ? '' : ' dim') + '"" data-k=""bd"" data-i=""' + i + '"">' +
        '<div class=""fco-rl"">' + esc(D.dim.bands[i]) + '</div>' +
        '<div class=""fco-rb""><div class=""fco-rf s' + i + '"" style=""width:' + w.toFixed(2) + '%""></div></div>' +
        '<div class=""fco-rv"">' + pct(share, 1) + '</div></div>';
    }

    h += '<div class=""fco-gh t"">By transaction type, count</div>';

    var maxT = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < D.dim.types.length; i++) { if (A.byType[i] > maxT) maxT = A.byType[i]; }
    for (i = 0; i < D.dim.types.length; i++) {
      var wt = maxT ? (A.byType[i] / maxT) * 100 : 0;

        '<div class=""fco-rl"">' + esc(label(D.dim.types[i])) + '</div>' +

  function panelRules() {
    var rules = (D.dim && D.dim.rules) || [];
    var h = '<div class=""fco-p"" style=""grid-row:2;grid-column:2"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-ph""><div class=""fco-pt"">Rule firings</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-pn"">report filter context</div></div>';

    if (!rules.length) {
      return h + '<div class=""fco-empty"">No rules in the payload.</div></div>';
    }
    var max = 0, i;
    for (i = 0; i < rules.length; i++) { if (rules[i][3] > max) max = rules[i][3]; }

    h += '<div class=""fco-tb""><table><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>Rule</th><th>Wt</th><th>Firings</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
    for (i = 0; i < rules.length; i++) {
      var r = rules[i];
      var w = max ? (r[3] / max) * 42 : 0;

        '<td>' + esc(r[2]) + '</td>' +
        '<td><b>' + num(r[3]) + '</b>' +
        '<span class=""fco-bar"" style=""width:' + w.toFixed(1) + 'px""></span></td></tr>';
    }
    h += '</tbody></table></div>';

    // the page is the difference between 39.6M ""alerts"" and 1.4M real ones.
    h += '<div class=""fco-pn"" style=""margin-top:6px;margin-left:0"">' +
      'A firing contributes to the score. An alert is the score crossing the band. '
      + 'These counts follow report filters, not the chips above.</div>';
    return h + '</div>';
  }


  /* =========================================================================
   * GUIDE PAGE
   * Seven sections behind a nav, a pipeline you can open a stage at a time, and
   * a threshold demonstrator that recomputes from the real score histogram.
   *
   * The demonstrator matters more than the prose around it. ""An alert is not a
   * rule firing"" is a sentence people nod at and then forget; dragging the
   * cut-off and watching 7.1m alerts become 51k, and 57 analysts become none,
   * is the thing that actually lands.
   * ====================================================================== */

  var GSECTIONS = [
    ['start', 'Start here'],
    ['pipeline', 'How the data gets here'],
    ['alerts', 'Firing vs alert'],
    ['pages', 'The pages'],
    ['numbers', 'Reading the numbers'],
    ['quality', 'Data quality'],
    ['limits', 'What this cannot do']
  ];

  var GSTAGES = [
    ['PostgreSQL', 'on-premises',
     'A single wide table, 100 columns, every one of them text. Nothing is ' +
     'cleaned on the way in: a landing zone that rejects rows is not a landing ' +
     'zone. Values like <code>1,234.50</code>, <code>(45.00)</code>, ' +
     '<code>RM99.00</code> and <code>9999-12-31</code> all land exactly as the ' +
     'source produced them.'],
    ['Open mirroring', 'Postgres to OneLake',
     'Fabric cannot reach a database on localhost, and PostgreSQL on-premises ' +
     'is not a supported native mirroring source. So the publisher writes ' +
     'Parquet into a landing zone and Fabric applies it to Delta tables: an ' +
     'initial seed, then continuous change data capture from the write-ahead ' +
     'log. Inserts, updates and deletes all propagate.'],
    ['DuckDB', 'clean, conform, model',
     'Typing, parsing and conforming happen here, on 8 vCores. Five competing ' +
     'date formats resolved, 32 spellings of one country collapsed to one code, ' +
     'exact duplicates removed, then a star schema with explicit Unknown ' +
     'members so no fact is ever orphaned by a missing dimension.'],
    ['Direct Lake', 'the semantic model',
     'Nine tables, eight relationships, seventeen measures over the gold layer. ' +
     'Direct Lake reads the Delta files directly: no import, no refresh window, ' +
     'and no copy of the data sitting in a second place going stale.'],
    ['This report', 'one measure per page',
     'Each page is a single HTML visual. Its measure aggregates in the model ' +
     'and ships a compact cube; the browser does layout, ranking and filtering ' +
     'from there. Clicking inside a page never queries the model again.']
  ];

  function gnav() {
    var cur = S.gsec || 'start';
    var h = '<div class=""fco-gnav"">';
    for (var i = 0; i < GSECTIONS.length; i++) {
      var id = GSECTIONS[i][0];
      h += '<div class=""fco-gn' + (id === cur ? ' on' : '') +
        '"" data-k=""gsec"" data-v=""' + id + '"">' +
        '<span class=""fco-gnn"">' + (i + 1) + '</span>' +
        esc(GSECTIONS[i][1]) + '</div>';
    }
    return h + '</div>';
  }

  /* Alerts above a cut-off, straight off the histogram. A tail sum is all a
   * threshold ever is, which is why this needs no round trip. */
  function alertsAbove(cut) {
    var hist = D.hist || [], n = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < hist.length; i += 2) {
      if (hist[i] >= cut) n += hist[i + 1];
    }
    return n;
  }

  function gThresholdDemo() {
    var m = D.meta || {};
    var lo = 10, hi = Math.min(100, m.maxScore || 145);
    var cur = S.gthr == null ? (m.threshold || 60) : S.gthr;
    var al = alertsAbove(cur);
    var rate = m.txns ? al / m.txns : 0;
    var years = al / 50000;
    var fte = years / 2.5;
    var isDefault = (cur === (m.threshold || 60));

    var h = '<div class=""fco-demo"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-demo-h"">Move the cut-off and watch what it costs</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-chips"">';
    for (var c = lo; c <= hi; c += 10) {
      h += '<span class=""fco-chip' + (c === cur ? ' on' : '') +
        '"" data-k=""gthr"" data-v=""' + c + '"">' + c + '</span>';
    }
    h += '</div><div class=""fco-demo-out"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-do""><div class=""fco-dol"">Alerts raised</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-dov"">' + full(al) + '</div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-do""><div class=""fco-dol"">Alert rate</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-dov"">' + pct(rate, 2) + '</div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-do""><div class=""fco-dol"">Analyst years</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-dov"">' + years.toFixed(1) + '</div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-do lead""><div class=""fco-dol"">Analysts needed</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-dov"">' + fte.toFixed(0) + '</div></div>' +
      '</div>';

    // The distribution, with the chosen cut-off marked.
    var hist = D.hist || [], maxH = 0, i;
    for (i = 0; i < hist.length; i += 2) { if (hist[i + 1] > maxH) maxH = hist[i + 1]; }
    h += '<div class=""fco-demo-hist"">';
    for (i = 0; i < hist.length; i += 2) {
      var bk = hist[i];
      var ph = maxH ? (hist[i + 1] / maxH) * 100 : 0;
      h += '<div class=""fco-dhb"" title=""score ' + bk + ' to ' + (bk + 4) + ': ' +
        full(hist[i + 1]) + '""><div class=""fco-dhf' + (bk >= cur ? ' on' : '') +
        '"" style=""height:' + ph.toFixed(2) + '%""></div></div>';
    }
    h += '</div><div class=""fco-demo-ax""><span>score 0</span><span>' +
      (hist.length ? hist[hist.length - 2] + 4 : 145) + '</span></div>';

    h += '<div class=""fco-note"">' +
      (isDefault
        ? 'This is the threshold the model actually uses: the HIGH band starts ' +
          'at <b>' + cur + '</b>.'
        : 'The model uses <b>' + (m.threshold || 60) + '</b>. At <b>' + cur +
          '</b> the queue would be ' +
          (al > (m.alerts || 0) ? 'larger' : 'smaller') + ', needing ' +
          fte.toFixed(0) + ' analysts instead of ' +
          ((m.alerts || 0) / 50000 / 2.5).toFixed(0) + '.') +
      '</div></div>';
    return h;
  }

  function gFiringVsAlert() {
    var m = D.meta || {};
    var wr = m.txnsWithRule || 0, al = m.alerts || 0, tx = m.txns || 1;
    var wrPct = wr / tx, alPct = al / tx;
    return '<div class=""fco-compare"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp-t"">If any rule firing were an alert</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp-bar""><div class=""fco-cmp-f bad"" style=""width:' +
      (wrPct * 100).toFixed(1) + '%""></div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp-v"">' + full(wr) + ' <span>' + pct(wrPct, 1) +
      ' of transactions</span></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp-n"">About ' + Math.round(wr / 50000 / 2.5) +
      ' full-time analysts. Nobody staffs that, so in practice the queue is ' +
      'ignored and the control stops working.</div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp"">' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp-t"">Scoring, then alerting on the score</div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp-bar""><div class=""fco-cmp-f good"" style=""width:' +
      Math.max(alPct * 100, 0.6).toFixed(1) + '%""></div></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp-v"">' + full(al) + ' <span>' + pct(alPct, 2) +
      ' of transactions</span></div>' +
      '<div class=""fco-cmp-n"">About ' + Math.round(al / 50000 / 2.5) +
      ' analysts. A queue this size can actually be worked, which is the only ' +
      'reason the numbers on the other pages mean anything.</div></div></div>';
  }

  function gSection(id) {
    var m = D.meta || {};
    var h = '';

    if (id === 'start') {
      h += '<p class=""fco-lede"">This pack monitors <b>' + full(m.txns || 0) +

      h += '<div class=""fco-stats"">' +
        gstat(full(m.txns || 0), 'transactions') +
        gstat(full(m.customers || 0), 'customers') +
        gstat(full(m.alerts || 0), 'alerts raised') +
        gstat(esc(m.nRules || 0), 'scoring rules') +

      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>What makes this report unusual</h3>' +

        '<p>That sounds like a stunt and is not. A custom visual cannot ' +
        'cross-filter its neighbours unless its own compiled code builds ' +
        'selection identities, which this one does not. Rather than fight that, ' +

      h += '<p class=""fco-lede"">Five stages, each deliberately constrained so ' +

      var cur = S.gstage == null ? 0 : S.gstage;
      for (var i = 0; i < GSTAGES.length; i++) {
        h += '<div class=""fco-stage' + (i === cur ? ' on' : '') +

          '<div class=""fco-stage-t"">' + esc(GSTAGES[i][0]) + '</div>' +
          '<div class=""fco-stage-s"">' + esc(GSTAGES[i][1]) + '</div></div>';
        if (i < GSTAGES.length - 1) h += '<div class=""fco-arrow"">›</div>';
      }
      h += '</div>';
      var st = GSTAGES[S.gstage == null ? 0 : S.gstage];
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>' + esc(st[0]) + ' ' + DOT + ' ' +
        esc(st[1]) + '</h3><p>' + st[2] + '</p></div>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>Why the measure ships a cube</h3>' +
        '<p>A DAX measure holds roughly <b>2,100,000 characters</b>. Shipping ' +
        full(m.txns || 0) + ' rows at grain would need about <b>1.7 billion</b>, ' +
        'roughly 800 times over.</p>' +
        '<p>So each measure aggregates first and ships a small cube: the ' +
        'Overview uses month x channel x risk band x transaction type, 2,508 ' +
        'populated cells, about 4% of the ceiling. The browser re-aggregates ' +
        'that cube on every click. The trade is explicit: you can slice on the ' +
        'dimensions a page ships and no others.</p></div>';
      return h;
    }

    if (id === 'alerts') {
      h += '<p class=""fco-lede"">This is the one idea worth reading twice. A ' +
        '<b>rule firing</b> contributes points to a transaction risk score. An ' +
        '<b>alert</b> is that score crossing a threshold. Treating the two as ' +

        'stops working.</p>';
      h += gFiringVsAlert();
      h += gThresholdDemo();
      return h;
    }

    if (id === 'pages') {
      h += '<p class=""fco-lede"">Three analytics pages, each shipping its own ' +
        'cube at the grain its questions need.</p>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-cols2"">';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>Overview</h3>' +
        '<p>Alert volume and value over time, by channel, risk band and ' +
        'transaction type. Chips filter all four dimensions at once, and ' +
        'clicking a month bar filters to it. Start here.</p>' +
        '<p class=""fco-dim"">Cube: month x channel x band x type</p></div>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>Rule effectiveness</h3>' +
        '<p>Which rules fire and how often, how many fire together on one ' +
        'transaction, the full score distribution, and a table pricing each ' +
        'cut-off in analyst headcount.</p>' +
        '<p class=""fco-dim"">Cubes: rules, rules-fired x band, score histogram</p>' +
        '</div>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>Risk and exposure</h3>' +
        '<p>Where risk concentrates: merchant category, settlement currency, ' +

      h += '</div>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>How filtering behaves</h3>' +
        '<p>The chips at the top of a page filter <b>inside the browser</b>. ' +

    }

    if (id === 'numbers') {
      h += '<p class=""fco-lede"">Four conventions worth knowing before you quote ' +

      h += '<div class=""fco-cols2"">';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>Money crosses as integers</h3>' +

      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>Counts are exact</h3>' +

      h += '</div>';
      return h;
    }

    if (id === 'quality') {
      h += '<p class=""fco-lede"">The source is deliberately ungoverned, and the ' +

        'most demos quietly skip.</p>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-cols2"">';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>What the source looked like</h3>' +
        '<p>100 columns, all text. Five competing date formats in one column, ' +
        'sentinel dates like <code>9999-12-31</code>, money as ' +
        '<code>1,234.50</code> and <code>(45.00)</code> and ' +
        '<code>RM99.00</code>, null written eight different ways, and <b>' +
        full(m.dupes || 0) + '</b> exact duplicate rows.</p></div>';
      h += '<div class=""fco-sec""><h3>What cleaning recovered</h3>' +
